# TPC-DS-OBT Q17

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT item_i_item_id, item_i_item_desc, store_s_state, COUNT(quantity) AS store_sales_quantitycount, AVG(quantity) AS store_sales_quantityave, STDDEV_SAMP(quantity) AS store_sales_quantitystdev, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(quantity) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(quantity), 0) AS store_sales_quantitycov, COUNT(return_quantity) AS store_returns_quantitycount, AVG(return_quantity) AS store_returns_quantityave, STDDEV_SAMP(return_quantity) AS store_returns_quantitystdev, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(return_quantity) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(return_quantity), 0) AS store_returns_quantitycov, COUNT(quantity) AS catalog_sales_quantitycount, AVG(quantity) AS catalog_sales_quantityave, STDDEV_SAMP(quantity) AS catalog_sales_quantitystdev, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(quantity) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(AVG(quantity), 0) AS catalog_sales_quantitycov FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (sold_date_d_quarter_name = '1998Q1' AND sold_date_d_date_sk = sold_date_sk AND item_i_item_sk = item_sk AND store_s_store_sk = store_sk AND ship_customer_sk = returning_customer_c_customer_sk AND item_sk = item_sk AND sale_id = sale_id AND returned_date_sk = return_date_d_date_sk AND return_date_d_quarter_name IN ('1998Q1', '1998Q2', '1998Q3') AND returning_customer_c_customer_sk = bill_customer_sk AND item_sk = item_sk AND sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk AND sold_date_d_quarter_name IN ('1998Q1', '1998Q2', '1998Q3')) AND channel IN ('catalog', 'store') GROUP BY item_i_item_id, item_i_item_desc, store_s_state ORDER BY item_i_item_id, item_i_item_desc, store_s_state LIMIT 100
```
